title: Paired Median-of-Means Rewards for Robust Configuration Selection in Vector Search Benchmarking

contributions.purpose: Reliably rank ANNS configurations despite environmental noise in wall-clock QPS measurements.
contributions.mechanism: Paired Median-of-Means (Paired-MoM): paired randomized-order back-to-back execution of candidate and reference configs to cancel additive drift via log speedup ratios, plus median-of-means aggregation to suppress heavy-tailed outliers.
contributions.evaluation: Kendall tau rises from 0.458 to 0.840 (+83%) on GIST-960 and 0.875 to 0.925 (+5.7%) on SIFT-128, versus standard estimation reaching 0% top-1 on high-noise data.
contributions.source_quote: A paired execution protocol that dramatically improves ranking accuracy, increasing Kendall tau from 0.458 to 0.840 (+83%) on GIST-960 and from 0.875 to 0.925 (+5.7%) on SIFT-128.

contributions.purpose: Attribute the accuracy gain to the two Paired-MoM components.
contributions.mechanism: Ablation isolating drift cancellation through pairing versus MoM aggregation.
contributions.evaluation: Pairing (drift cancellation) is dominant, contributing over 95% of the improvement, while MoM provides only marginal additional benefit at limited budgets.
contributions.source_quote: Ablation analysis revealing that drift cancellation through pairing is the dominant factor, contributing over 95% of the improvement, while MoM aggregation provides marginal additional benefit at limited budgets.

contributions.purpose: Characterize measurement-budget efficiency of the estimator.
contributions.mechanism: Budget efficiency analysis comparing Paired-MoM against baselines across measurement budgets.
contributions.evaluation: Paired-MoM reaches tau>=0.90 at budget 30 on SIFT-128 (no baseline reaches it) and dominates all baselines from budget 6 on GIST-960.
contributions.source_quote: Budget efficiency analysis showing Paired-MoM achieves tau>=0.90 at budget 30 on SIFT-128 (no baseline reaches this threshold) and dominates all baselines from budget 6 on GIST-960.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our paired execution protocol draws inspiration from duet benchmarking, extending the differential measurement principle to ANNS configuration selection with robust aggregation.
Our work applies MoM aggregation to paired performance measurements, combining drift cancellation with heavy-tail robustness.

notes: Positive-result method paper. Internal caveat: ablation shows the MoM component adds only marginal benefit (pairing does >95% of the work), a partial negative finding about half of the proposed method.
